description: ParseError implements Display and From<ParseError> for String but does not implement std::error::Error. This means it cannot be used with the ? operator in functions returning Result<_, Box<dyn Error>> or returned as a source() from another error type. Adding impl std::error::Error for ParseError {} (empty body, since there is no source to chain) would be the correct Rust idiom for a leaf error type.
title: sieve-native: ParseError does not implement std::error::Error
